description:
`petite chute` is a piece about color exploration and palettes

it's just something soothing that I like to stare at, and makes me feel good

it's a 16x16 grid of pixels, with a background color

the name `petite chute` means `little fall` or `little waterfall` and comes from the fact that this piece is a derivative of THE FALL:  https://www.fxhash.xyz/generative/slug/the-fall-2

sometimes, the color cycle will perfectly loop, so look out for that if you like it

also, I didn't originally intend for this but to my surprise thanks to the entropy locking it is possible to generate a black and white output... I have seen it once out of thousands of outputs so keep an eye out for that too


controls:
s -> save png
n -> resume animation
p -> pause animation
r -> change randomness and generate new output

scales to any aspect ratio and display size automatically, but will reload the page so you'll lose the one you're looking at


minted for Objkt4Objkt4 on 2024-04-18
name: petite chute
